Permanently deletes up to 1000 contacts by id, or every contact matching q, segmentId and filter. With match, pass the preview's count as expectedCount; if the live count differs nothing is deleted (409 count_changed, with the new count). info.title: SendLit API
info.description: SendLit REST API for composing, sending and automating email. Most team-scoped routes accept a team API key or Better Auth OAuth2 bearer token. Provisioning and selected organization routes accept scoped organization API keys; some routes require user authentication.

tags.name: Segments
tags.description: Saved, named, reusable contact filters - build a filter once, reuse it across broadcasts and sequences.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Team-wide tags: list them with contact counts, see where one is used, rename or delete it.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Authenticated MediaLit upload signatures for dashboard-owned media.

tags.name: Transactional Emails
tags.description: Single API-triggered sends (receipts, password resets, ...) — no audience filter, no unsubscribe footer, delivered immediately.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Custom events sent for a contact (`course purchased`, `trial ending`, ...). Sequences can start on them, and their properties render as {{ event.* }}.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: Per-team settings, including email sending provider (SMTP) configuration and test sends.

tags.name: Teams
tags.description: Team management (list/create/rename/delete), per-team API keys, and server-to-server provisioning.

tags.name: Delivery
tags.description: Normalized bounce/complaint delivery events and the per-workspace suppression (do-not-send) list. See docs/bounces-and-complaints.md.
